visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-05-06
Patient: 78-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: blood pressure review; warts on hand
Blood pressure review: home readings have been running 150 to 160 systolic for a month, with morning headaches.
Examination: blood pressure 162/95, repeated after rest; heart sounds normal; no ankle swelling.
Decision: lisinopril increased from 10 mg to 20 mg; kidney function to be checked in two weeks.
Procedure: three common warts on the right hand treated with cryotherapy.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-05-06.

expected.expected_correction: Add modifier 25 to line 1 and send a corrected claim.
expected.rationale: Alongside the wart treatment, the note records a history, an examination and a treatment change for a different problem. That is a separately identifiable evaluation, so modifier 25 is supported.
